title: Nand Kishor v. State of U.P. & Ors.
coram: Laxmi Kanta Mohapatra, J.; Rakesh Srivastava, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; apply in prescribed form under cl. 4.4; consider within one month.
headnote: A writ seeking electric supply, where no application in the prescribed form under clause 4.4 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 had been filed, was disposed of with a direction that if the petitioner files such an application, the licensee shall consider it in accordance with law within one month.
facts: Nand Kishor petitioned the Allahabad High Court for a direction to supply an electric connection. Counsel for the distribution licensee (respondents 2 and 3) submitted that an application for a new connection had to be made in the prescribed form under clause 4.4 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and that no such application had been filed. Counsel for the petitioner and for the State were also heard.

holding_units.holding: Where no application for a new electric connection has been made in the prescribed form under clause 4.4 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005, the Court will not mandamus supply; it will direct that if the petitioner files such an application, the licensee shall consider it in accordance with law within one month.

not_decided.point: entitlement to a new connection on merits
not_decided.note: No finding on occupancy, owner consent, indemnity bond, or other clause 4.4 conditions; relegated to a prescribed-form application.
